description: Fetch the full text of a command by slug, with {{variables}} filled from the values you pass. Unfilled variables are listed so you can ask the user for them.

slug.description: The command's slug from search_commands or its URL (commandvault.ai/commands/<slug>).

variables.description: Values for the command's {{blanks}}, keyed by variable name.

name: get_command
title: Get a command
